name: F1 Client
description: Standalone client-side mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 (Mojang mappings): a glass ClickGUI on Right Shift, a HUD, per-profile configs and a settings system around OreESP (F7), SoundESP (F8), Freecam (F6) and the HUD. Reads only what the client already has; never touches a packet.
